summary: UTime Ltd filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, reporting that it entered into restricted stock unit grant agreements with each of its five directors, granting each 200,000 RSUs vesting immediately. This is a routine equity grant to directors, disclosed as a foreign private issuer current report. There are no deal terms, premium, or special situation elements. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. It is a standard compensatory grant, not a special situation.
